profile.headline: Software Engineer Supervisor at Advanced Systems Technology, Inc. (AST)
profile.summary: Background encompasses more than twenty four years of experience in Management Information Systems with skills and accomplishments in the areas of network administration, technical support, configuration management and software programming. I am a self motivated, conscientious individual with strong interpersonal and organizational skills. Able to manage time productively, handle multiple projects simultaneously and perform well under pressure.  I am dedicated and detail oriented, with a proven analytical problem-solving skills throughout my career. I have been involved in many aspects of management information systems including technical support, troubleshooting, database administration and software testing, installation and programming.  In addition, I developed a track record of increasing efficiency and productivity while maintaining positive customer relations.

company.name: U.S. Army Network Enterprise Technology Command

positions.title: Software Engineer Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Designed, implemented and upgraded the CDOCS entire platform from a VAX 8350 legacy system to a modern PC with no code changes.  
•	Initiated and successfully fielded Charon –VAX emulator, resulting in saving the government money and reduced obsolescence risk. 
•	Responsibilities include Node Administrator for the Contingency DSCS Operational Support System (CDOCS).  Set-up CMUIP a TCP/IP communication package for the VAX.  Provide continue support for the network administration.  Review and modify test procedures for software government acceptance. Provide continual software coding support for four systems as well as hardware support, networking and all technical issues (includes SPCR’s, printers, and routers, switches, cabling and help desk).  
•	Implement IAVM support for the ARMY GOLD MASTER and maintain ATO requirements for five systems. Utilizing scan tools to reduce security risks like Army Gold Disk, Retina with S-CAP, SPAWARS(S-CAP tool) and Microsoft’s MBSA tool.  
•	Produced reports to support system vulnerabilities and provide installation procedures to update current IAVA patches and Stigs as well as the SCP report to support DISA requirements.
•	Travel to government installations to maintain and install hardware and software for current contract support.  
•	Work with contractors/sub-contractors to support current missions. 
•	Install equipment for satellite connectivity such as up and down converters and Fiber to RF transceivers to maintain connection to satellite. To implement DISA certified terminal approved platform for communication to the DSCS III satellite. 
•	Maintained CMMI level 3 process during the entire time.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
•	Provide in-house support for computer software, hardware and configuration management to all Naval sites. Re-host OMS from FOCUS RDBS to Microsoft SQL Server under Windows NT.
•	Maintain contractual support to foreign governments for computer software & hardware configuration management.

 Major Projects:
•	Implemented computer support and software upgrade through a secured FTP Site to foreign governments.
•	Installed DEC UNIX to support and maintain software computer configuration upgrades.
•	Installed software on Alpha Workstation for approximately 115 machines to support Consolidated Automated Support System (CASS program) for the Naval Fleet under contract.
•	Physically installed Alpha system on Aircraft Carriers and Naval Bases across the Continental U.S.
•	Administered upgrades for system and application software to Naval Fleet for Off-Line Reader System (OLRS).
•	Wrote and maintained current database in MS Access for tracking serial number and locations as well as system trouble reporting for all Off-Line Reader System distributed to the fleet.
•	Performed functional duties for the SPR (software problem reporting) team; generated SPR's to report software bugs for improvements for future P3I efforts.
•	Successfully installed and tested TCP/IP (CMUIP freeware) on the CASS Station and Digital UCX on the Alpha Station to provide a low cost solution for communications and provide remote maintenance to the Naval support teams.
•	The outcome is now a P3I effort.
•	Performed duties well beyond job description with emphasis on continual improvements to support the Naval Fleet.
